test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: [October 2024] Mongla Port, recently seen in the news for strategic development and trade ties, is located in which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangladesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mongla Port** is located in the southwestern part of **Bangladesh**, in the Bagerhat district, and is the country's second-largest seaport.
 
• It is strategically situated on the **Pasur River**, approximately 62 km north of the Bay of Bengal, providing access to both domestic and international trade routes.
 
• The port has recently gained significant importance due to its **strategic development initiatives** and increased trade activities, particularly under the **India-Bangladesh bilateral agreements**.
 
• In recent years, Mongla Port has been modernized to handle larger vessels and increased cargo volumes, making it a crucial hub for regional trade and commerce.
 
• The port serves as a vital link for the **Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, and Nepal (BBIN) sub-regional cooperation**, facilitating cross-border trade and connectivity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Location and Significance of Mongla Port:**

 
 
• Mongla Port is situated at the confluence of the **Pasur and Mongla Rivers**, which provides a natural harbor for large vessels.
 
• It is approximately **48 km** south of Khulna, the nearest major city, and is connected by road and rail networks.
 
• Its location near the **Sundarbans**, the world's largest mangrove forest, adds ecological significance to its geographical importance.
 
 
 
• **Strategic Developments:**
 
 
• The Government of Bangladesh has partnered with international organizations and neighboring countries, including **India**, to enhance the port's capacity and infrastructure.
 
• The port has been equipped with modern facilities, including container terminals, to accommodate larger ships and facilitate efficient cargo handling.
 
• Improved infrastructure at Mongla Port has allowed it to support the growing trade demands of Bangladesh and its neighboring countries, particularly through the BBIN initiative.
 
 
 
• **India-Bangladesh Trade Relations:**
 
 
• India and Bangladesh have signed agreements to use Mongla Port for transshipment of goods to and from India, particularly for the northeastern states of India.
 
• This development is part of broader regional cooperation efforts, aiming to boost economic growth and connectivity in South Asia.
 
• Mongla Port is one of the key components of the **BIMSTEC (Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation)** framework.
 
 
 
• **Important Features of Mongla Port:**
 
 
• The port can handle vessels with a maximum draft of **9.5 meters** and a length of up to **225 meters**.
 
• It primarily handles commodities like **fertilizers, food grains, cement, and industrial raw materials**, as well as general cargo and containers.
 
• The port has a number of jetties, warehouses, and other facilities to support its operations efficiently.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Major Ports in Bangladesh:**

 
 
• **Chattogram Port:** The largest and busiest seaport in Bangladesh, handling the majority of the country's imports and exports.
 
• **Payra Port:** A relatively new port aimed at boosting trade and reducing pressure on Chattogram and Mongla ports.
 
 
 
• **India-Bangladesh Connectivity Projects:**
 
 
• The **Agartala-Akhaura Rail Link** project aims to improve connectivity between India's northeast and Bangladesh.
 
• India and Bangladesh are also collaborating on multimodal transport projects, such as inland waterways and coastal shipping agreements, to enhance trade and economic ties.
 
 
 
• **Geopolitical Importance:**
 
 
• Mongla Port plays a strategic role in China's Belt and Road Initiative (BRI), as Bangladesh is a member of the initiative.
 
• The port's development is significant for countering regional influence and fostering cooperation within South Asia.
